lines.text: The tabernacle had two rooms, and the ark held the gold jar of manna and the stone tablets.
Only the high priest entered the second room, and only once a year, never without blood.
The gifts and sacrifices could not cleanse the worshiper's conscience and dealt only with food, drink, and special washings.
Christ entered the Holy Place once for all by His own blood, securing eternal redemption.
Through the eternal Spirit, Christ offered Himself unblemished to God to purify our consciences from works of the law.
